columns.comment: ER run id ER-yyyymmdd.

columns.comment: client_group_id, or UNATTRIBUTED for exposure on records the run could not attribute to a group.
columns.name: group_key

columns.comment: As-of date of the ER run and of the exposure snapshot (the grain date).
columns.name: run_date

columns.comment: Rule set of the run (v1 or v2).
columns.name: rule_version

columns.comment: Run sequence 1-6 in date order.
columns.name: run_seq

columns.comment: True for the latest run (ER-20260930).
columns.name: is_latest_run

columns.comment: True for the first run of a new rule set (ER-20260331 = first v2 run - the March 2026 resolution).

columns.comment: Client group (SYN-G-nnnn); null on the UNATTRIBUTED row. Join gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: dim_client surrogate key of the group's lead entity (version valid on this row's date) - the client attributes used for group-grain facts (D12).
columns.name: lead_golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Attributed (records resolved to a group) or Unattributed.
columns.name: attribution_status

columns.comment: Golden clients of the group holding the exposure records under this run.
columns.name: n_golden_clients

columns.comment: Credit obligor records attributed to the group under this run.
columns.name: n_obligor_records

columns.comment: Trade party records attributed to the group under this run.
columns.name: n_trade_party_records

columns.comment: Drawn lending in USD at the run date (core facility balances of the attributed obligor records).
columns.name: lending_drawn_usd

columns.comment: Trade finance outstanding in USD at the run date (instruments of the attributed trade party records).
columns.name: trade_outstanding_usd

columns.comment: Group credit exposure in USD under this run's resolution = lending drawn + trade outstanding (point-in-time).
columns.name: total_exposure_usd

columns.comment: The same run-date exposure attributed with the previous run's resolution (null for the first run).
columns.name: prior_resolution_exposure_usd

columns.comment: Change vs the previous run as a fraction of prev_run_exposure_usd.
columns.name: change_vs_prev_run_pct

columns.comment: Single-borrower attention threshold in USD (500m; gold.dim_threshold SINGLE_BORROWER_ATTENTION_USD).

columns.name: is_above_threshold

columns.comment: True when the prior-resolution exposure was already at or above the threshold.
columns.name: was_above_threshold_before_resolution

columns.comment: True when re-resolution in this run moved the group across the attention threshold (Meridian at ER-20260331).
columns.name: crossed_threshold_on_resolution

columns.comment: True when |resolution_change_pct| > 20% (gold.dim_threshold ER_EXPOSURE_CHANGE) - the exposures that changed by more than 20% after a resolution.
columns.name: is_material_resolution_change

comment: Why entity resolution matters: credit exposure of each client group under each quarterly ER run (USD) = drawn lending + trade finance outstanding at the run date, attributed to the group through that run's resolution, beside the same exposure attributed with the previous run's resolution. resolution_change isolates the effect of re-resolution (e.g. Meridian Agri Holdings +38% at the Mar-2026 v2 run, crossing the USD 500m single-borrower attention threshold); change_vs_prev_run also includes balance movements. Point-in-time per run: never sum exposure across runs. Exposure not attributable to any group is one UNATTRIBUTED row per run. Grain: one row per ER run per client group (group_key UNATTRIBUTED for unattributed exposure).
